marta: Heads-up: we need to lock the Q3 model-catalog runway. Proposal here: staggered cutover across 3 cohorts (shadow -> soft-pin -> full-swap). Goal is low-friction customer migrations and predictable cost impact.
kevin: Quick capacity sketch: cohort sizes 30/30/40. Reserve dedicated canary capacity +20% buffer. Expect token QPS uplift ~+18% during soft-pin ramp. Need to size GPU pools and autoscale hot paths.
sophia: Bench & acceptance proposal: run 1k sample prompts per cohort (customer-sampled) + 200 edge cases. Pass gates: p95 latency <= 300ms hosted gen, embed recall >= 0.88 on sample, safety fail rate = 0. Delta to baseline < 2% per-task. If any gate fails, halt rollout.
jules: Infra/ML constraints: every model variant must publish a quant profile. If we fallback to quantized compat variant, tag it as 'compat-q' and run stability-run every 12h. Also verify KV cache warmup curve for long-chat workloads.
marta: Operational policy: soft-pin TTL = 30 days. If user-visible regressions exceed thresholds (safety/accuracy/latency) escalate to a 7-day rollback window automatically. Enterprise customers can file manual pin-exceptions.
kevin: Rollback/playbook notes: traffic shifts in 10% steps every 6 hours. Canary fail rule: >5% failed checks across three consecutive runs -> auto-route traffic back to previous pin. Ops will add synthetic canary probes for embed recall and safety checks.
jules: Compatibility shim: ship a lightweight adapter to normalize prompt schema for V2 models; estimated dev effort ~2 engineer-weeks. This reduces migration churn for customers using older prompt shapes.
sophia: Bench harness standardization: harness outputs P50/P95/P99 latency, token cost, per-task accuracy, embed recall, and safety metrics. A/B config should produce a delta report and sample-level diffs.
meng-bot: canary created: catalog-q3-cohort1 (id: canary-176500). Monitoring targets: p95_latency, embed_recall, safety_fail_rate. Alerts -> #incidents if thresholds tripped.
eng-bot: Added runbook checklist: bench dataset commit, compat-adapter PR link, canary capacity commit, comms draft.
marta: Comms & incentives: 2-week notice email + Console 1-click downgrade. Offer migration credits for early-cohort opt-ins and a fallback SLA for first 30 days.
sophia: I'll draft the migration email and the migration-credit terms and loop in Sales & AE.
kevin: I'll post capacity delta and cost impact by EOD tomorrow, including Dedicated pool sizing for cohort1.
jules: I'll open the compat-adapter RFC and a bench-harness PR by Wednesday. Will include automated stability-run job.
marta: Decision items before next Thurs: 1) confirm bench pass thresholds, 2) approve soft-pin TTL and exception flow, 3) sign off on canary traffic schedule, 4) capacity commit for cohort1. If no objections, schedule first canary for 2026-07-07. :white_check_mark:
kevin: No objections from infra side.
sophia: Fine from PM/Comms.
jules: Good from ML infra.
marta: Great. Owners: @kevin, @jules, @sophia. Will cut runbook and attach to the canary thread.
